C2.where: home phone.01 hero image vs home 'Before you start'

C6.where: quick-start phone, at-the-till phone; home phone.01 hero image

C7.worst_defect: Lighthouse mobile LCP is 2.4 s, with 150 ms render-blocking and 53 KiB unused JS on / and /docs/quick-start. The 404 page carries no JSON-LD. Everything else (titles, descriptions, sitemap, llms.txt, search API, alt text, no overflow) is clean.

overall_worst.defect: A shop owner can't complete a refund without their developer. On plugin 0.3.0 every refund 'stays Pending until an administrator settles it with two Admin API calls; see Plugin setup'. Neither the home Refund row nor At the till's 'Refund a sale' links the exact settling section, or says plainly who does it, for every refund, and how long the order sits Pending.
overall_worst.where: home desktop.02 'Live demo or your own store' Refund row; at-the-till desktop.03 'Refund a sale' step 1
overall_worst.fix: Link the Refund row and At the till step 1 straight to Plugin setup #settle-a-dashboard-refund. Add one plain sentence: 'Each refund needs your developer (or whoever runs your Vendure server) to run two calls; until then the order shows Pending. Card money is returned on your terminal and cash with Pay out, so the customer isn't kept waiting.'
